name: PostHog
tagline: First-party collection and a dashboard that answers your top five questions is one sitting of work, and PostHog's free tier covers a million events a month before you pay anything. What the bill buys past that is the rest of the platform: session replay, feature flags, SQL over years of events, and ingestion that stays correct while your event schema drifts underneath it.
verdictSummary: NOT REALLY: PostHog has usage-based pricing. Here's why it survives vibecoding.
